name: anima-felix-agent-skills
description: An Anima Felix skill for responding to anxiety with a calm, structured reset.

interface.shortDescription: A calm, bounded way to respond to anxiety: one grounding step, one next action, and a firm refusal to become a reassurance machine.
interface.longDescription: anxiety-reset gives an assistant a short protocol for someone who is spiraling, panicking, overthinking, or awake at 3am. It offers one intervention at a time rather than stacking techniques, offers a tentative organizing category for the loop the person is caught in, and refuses to keep supplying reassurance that briefly soothes and then wears off. It hands off rather than assessing: on any sign of crisis or a possible medical emergency it stops, says plainly that it is not the right tool, and directs the person to local emergency services and a person nearby. It administers no psychological instrument, offers no diagnosis, and gives no medication guidance. It is wellness support, not therapy, diagnosis, treatment or crisis care.
defaultPrompt: I'm spiraling and I can't slow my thoughts down.
It's 3am and I can't shut my brain off.
I keep asking for reassurance about the same worry.
